name: Scaffold-Spider

Traits.name: Ceiling Purchase
Traits.text: The scaffold-spider climbs sheer walls and ceilings without an ability check and ignores Difficult Terrain on vertical surfaces, even while using a Reeling Line.
Traits.clause: The scaffold-spider ignores Difficult Terrain on vertical surfaces and can climb sheer walls and ceilings without an abi
Traits.expresses: never descends from its overhead scaffold
Traits.expressedQuote: even while using a Reeling Line

Traits.name: Overhead Stalker
Traits.text: The scaffold-spider ignores Difficult Terrain, and Opportunity Attacks against it are made with Disadvantage.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The scaffold-spider makes three attacks, using Mandibles or Reeling Line in any combination.

Actions.name: Mandibles
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

Actions.name: Reeling Line
Actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 20/60 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. *Hit or Miss:* Immediately after the attack, a weighted anchor returns to the scaffold-spider's grasp. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Restrained condition until the end of the scaffold-spider's next turn. This effect can be applied only once per turn.
weldedRiders: If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Restrained condition until the end of the scaffold-spider's next turn. This effect can be applied only once per turn.

Actions.name: Debris Drop (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: The scaffold-spider hurls a weighted anchor at a point it can see within 90 feet. *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 14, each creature in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. *Failure:* 42 (12d6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it has the Prone condition. *Success:* Half damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Fleet Agility
Bonus Actions.text: The scaffold-spider takes the Dash or Disengage action.

lore: A scaffold-spider is grown, not born — a Monstrosity of fused scaffold-timbers and hardened chitin that haunts the half-built towers and ruin-frames of dead sites, hoarding cable and stone to rebuild its web of beams higher and higher.

unplaced.text: Nothing forces the scaffold-spider to descend: it cannot be knocked Prone off its perch, and a creature that tries to pull, shove, or drag it down must first succeed on a Strength saving throw against {dc}; on a failure the attempt is wasted.

generation.userConcept: a scaffold-spider that fights from the ceiling and never comes down

monsterDescription: a scaffold-spider that fights from the ceiling and never comes down
